name: unreleased-lock-evidence
text:
The facts a verified bundle establishes carry the time of the accepted verification.

`crates/evidence/src/lib.rs` verifies a portable evidence bundle. `verify_adoption` finds the event that `adoption_record.verification_seq` names in the retained verification log, requires an accepted `verification/result`, and returns the facts as `VerifiedAdoption`. Every event carries `time`, the writer's clock reading in milliseconds since the Unix epoch as the event was appended, and the returned facts leave it behind, so a reader that orders two bundles by when each was verified parses the retained logs again.

Add `pub verification_time_ms: i64` to `VerifiedAdoption`, as its last field, carrying the `time` of the event `verification_seq` names. The field is established from the bytes the digest pass verified, as every other field of that structure is. Add a unit test that a verified bundle reports the time its accepted result event states, and give the existing tests that build a `VerifiedAdoption` the new field.

The documents under docs/ describe the behavior. Each sentence below belongs in the document named before it, in the same words:
- docs/evidence.md: the facts a verified bundle establishes include the time the accepted verification event states, so two bundles can be ordered without reading their logs again.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: scripts/loc.sh, the release of checks/evidence.lock, the tests of foe-evidence, and clippy with warnings denied on the same crates.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
